image_description: A red airship (blimp) floating against a clear blue sky with a brownish hill in the lower foreground. The airship has a large, elongated red envelope with white stylized text/logos on the side and tail fins. A small gondola is suspended beneath the front-center of the envelope. Thin tether lines are visible extending downwards from the nose.
